mapper.select: SELECT class_id, academy_id, name, COALESCE(target_grade, 0) AS targetGrade, COALESCE(max_students, 0) AS maxStudents, description, created_at, updated_at FROM classes WHERE academy_id = #{academyId} ORDER BY class_id DESC
SELECT class_id, academy_id, name, target_grade, max_students, description, created_at, updated_at FROM classes WHERE class_id = #{classId} AND academy_id = #{academyId}
SELECT c.class_id, c.academy_id, c.name AS class_name FROM classes c WHERE c.class_id = #{classId} AND c.academy_id = #{academyId}
SELECT u.name FROM class_teachers ct JOIN users u ON ct.teacher_id = u.user_id WHERE ct.class_id = #{classId} AND u.academy_id = #{academyId} AND ct.role_type = 'MAIN' # LIMIT 1

SELECT u.user_id, u.name, u.email, u.phone, u.status FROM class_students cs JOIN users u ON cs.student_id = u.user_id WHERE cs.class_id = #{classId} AND u.academy_id = #{academyId} AND cs.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY u.name
mapper.update: UPDATE classes SET name = #{name}, target_grade = #{targetGrade}, max_students = #{maxStudents}, description = #{description}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE class_id = #{classId} AND academy_id = #{academyId}
